predict.question: Your toy launch lands with 90% of early fans and 10% of mainstream customers. Audience B has ten early fans and ninety mainstream customers. What overall percentage of audience B does it land with?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Crossing the Chasm distinguishes early adopters from mainstream customers who require different reasons to adopt.
modelBoundary: A averages {A}%; B averages {B}%. Segment rates stay 90% and 10%; only the weights change as the audience shifts. Adoption rates are stipulated; they are not observed customers or a test of the book.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
